name: Week 23 Legs — Depth Bank Grows (Spotlight: Bulgarian on the Smith + Calf Raise)
description:
Legs day, riding the confidence that showed up in W22.

Two small dials this week, both yours: the squat gets a **third working set at 80** — optional, and fine to end early, depth is still the cap. And the leg curl pyramid steps up to **80 / 90 / 100 / 110**, the top rung you flagged you were ready for.

The Bulgarian moves to its new home — the **Smith machine at 45** is now the default, not the fallback. The fixed track forces the deeper squat you liked, and the DBs are the alternate when it's busy.

Everything else holds. The depth is the progression; the numbers are settled.

dayOverview.theme: Building on W22's standout session — depth at 80 was the best it's ever felt, so the squat earns a third working set (optional, end-early OK) and the leg curl steps to a 80→110 pyramid. Bulgarian relocates to its preferred Smith-machine setup at 45. Spotlights rotate to the Bulgarian (new setup) and the calf raise. Leg press and incline RDL hold.

spotlights.why: It just changed setups, and that's exactly when a lift is worth watching. On the Smith at 45 the fixed bar path takes the balance tax off, so the front-heel drive does all the work and the squat goes deeper than the DB version allowed — you felt that immediately last week. The spotlight is about locking in the pattern on the new station: vertical torso, front shin honest, and the depth the track now gives you for free. The left side read stronger here last week, opposite of your upper-body lag, so it's also worth confirming both sides drive evenly.

The quietest lift on the day and the one that responds best to the thing you've been doing well everywhere else — a slow eccentric and a real stretch at the bottom. Calves are almost all about time under tension through a full range, and 'doing these slowly' has been the whole game. The spotlight is a nudge to treat the bottom stretch as the rep, hold it a beat, and not let this one turn into a bouncy afterthought at the end of the leg-press station.

dayOverview.rotationPlan: Legs spotlights rotate: W21 squat depth + incline RDL · W22 leg press ROM + seated leg curl · W23 Bulgarian (new Smith setup) + calf raise (current) · W24 back to squat depth + incline RDL.
watchpoints: **🔆 Squat: THIRD working set at 80 this week — optional, and fine to end it early** 🛑. Depth is still the only measure; the extra set is a small volume bump, not a reason to grind. If depth shortens or the legs are done, stop — a short clean set beats a long shallow one. Reduced-rep working sets stay (you like them).

**🔆 Bulgarian moves to the Smith machine @45 — this is now the DEFAULT, not the fallback** 🛑. The fixed track forces the deeper squat. DBs (double-50) are the alternate only when the Smith is taken. Vertical torso, front shin honest, both sides driving evenly.

**Leg curl steps up: 80 / 90 / 100 / 110 pyramid** 🔥. You held 100 'easy-ish' and called 110 yourself — this is that. Slow eccentric on every rung; if the tempo has to break to hit 110, keep 100 on the top set.
**🔆 Calf raise: slow eccentric, full stretch at the bottom, hold a beat** 🔥. Stays ON the leg press, same machine. The bottom stretch is the rep.
**Leg press holds 4 plates, ROM is the read** 🔥. W22 was 'very deep all sets' — that's the standard. Judge depth, not sensation.
**Incline RDL holds 45, the 3s eccentric + 2s pause is the work** 🛑. 'Still burning hard' last week — the tempo is doing what a plate would. Don't add load.
**Intensity tags:** 🔥 near-failure last set OK — leg press, calf raise, seated leg curl. 🛑 keep it shy, the cue is the cap — squat, Bulgarian, incline RDL.
**Cool-down stays QL-biased** — it's been a QL-heavy stretch of weeks.

sets.name: Warmup (incl. Cross-Leg Lateral Lean — QL/Psoas Release + Dead-Bug Core/QL Primer)

exercises.notes: Full depth, easy pace — find the range before it's loaded.
30s each side. QL release — give it the full beat.
Open the hips, both directions.
Shins — knee insurance.
Spinal warmup.
Hinged slightly forward, tight fists, thumbs tucked.
**Core/QL primer.** Ribs DOWN, low back flat to the floor.
Bodyweight, controlled — last thing before the ramp.

**LOAD:** 45 for round 1, 70 for round 2, 8 reps each.
- **The ramp is what makes 80 work fresh** — don't skip it
- Sit between the feet, full depth on every warmup rep
- Brace before the descent

sets.name: 🔆 Squat Working (80 — Depth; THIRD Set Optional) 🛑

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 80/side. **3 working sets now — the third is OPTIONAL and fine to end early.**
- **DEPTH is the only measure** — the reduced-rep sets you like, kept
- **Sit BETWEEN the feet**, knees tracking the toes, ribs down
- **Third set:** a small volume bump, NOT a grind. Stop the moment depth shortens or the legs are done — a short clean set beats a long shallow one. 🛑 never grind a squat to a stall

W22 was the best this has ever felt at 80 ('best feeling at this weight ever') — that's the floor rising through confidence and depth, not the number. Bank it.

sets.name: 🔆 Bulgarian Split Squat (Smith @45 = Default Now; Pigeon Between Sets) 🛑

exercises.equipment: Smith machine @45 + bench (DBs double-50 the alternate)
exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** Smith machine @45 + bench — **the default this week.** Double-50 DBs only if the Smith is taken.

**🔆 SPOTLIGHT — lock in the new setup:**
- **The fixed track forces the deeper squat** — let it. That's why this is now the primary setup
- **Front shin honest, torso tall**, weight through the whole front foot
- **Both sides drive evenly** — left read stronger last week; confirm the right matches it
- **Slow down, drive up**, no bounce off the back foot
- **Pigeon between sets** — hip flexors carry over from the KB days
- Not to failure; the cue is the cap

**Reflection:** does the Smith track let you sit deeper than the DBs did? If the depth is noticeably better, that's the case for keeping it the default.

sets.name: 🔆 Leg Press + Calf Raise Station (Same Machine — Deep ROM) 🔥

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 4 plates/side. 4 sets of 12. 🔥
- **Full depth every rep** — knees toward the chest, judge ROM not sensation
- **Feet mid-platform**, knees tracking the toes
- **Low back flat on the pad** — if the hips curl under, you've gone past your range
- W22 was 'very deep all sets' — that's the bar. Last set may go near failure once ROM is holding

**🔆 SPOTLIGHT — the bottom stretch is the rep.** 4 plates/side. 3 sets of 15. **Stay on the leg press — same machine.** 🔥
- **Full stretch at the bottom, HOLD a beat** — don't bounce
- **Slow eccentric** all the way down — that's been the whole game
- Squeeze hard at the top

**Reflection:** are you feeling the stretch at the bottom, or rushing through it to finish the station? Time under tension through the full range is the entire lift here.

sets.notes: Both lifts on the leg press. Do not walk away between them.

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** **80 → 90 → 100 → 110** ascending, one step per round — the pyramid steps up a rung this week.
- **Slow eccentric on every set** — that stays regardless of load
- **Hips planted**, no lifting off the pad to move the stack
- **Full squeeze, controlled all the way back**
- **110 is the top set you called** — the condition is that the slow eccentric survives it. If the tempo has to break to hit 110, keep 100 on top
🔥 Safe isolation — a near-failure top set is fair game if the tempo holds.

sets.name: Incline RDL (Hold 45 — the Pause Is the Work) 🛑

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 45lb plate. 3 sets of 15.
- **Tempo: 3s eccentric, 2s pause at the bottom** — the pause is the lift
- **Hinge at the hips**, soft knees, spine long
- **Feel the hamstring stretch**, don't chase the floor with the plate
- Squeeze the glutes to stand

'Still burning hard' at 45 with the pause last week — the tempo is doing a plate's worth of work. Hold 45.

sets.name: Cool-Down — 5 Min Recovery Block (Hip/QL-Biased for Legs Day)

exercises.notes: 30s each side. QL downshift.
45s each side. Hips and glutes.
30s each side.
45s each side.
Slow breathing — parasympathetic shift.

tips: **Squat: third working set at 80 this week — optional, fine to end early.** Depth is the cap; the extra set is a small bump, not a grind.
**Leg curl pyramid steps up to 80 → 90 → 100 → 110** — the top set you called. Keep 100 on top if the slow eccentric can't survive 110.
**Bulgarian is on the Smith @45 by default now** — the track forces the deeper squat. DBs are the alternate.
**Calf raise spotlight: slow eccentric, hold the bottom stretch.** Stays on the leg press.
**Leg press holds 4 plates** — judge ROM, not how it feels.
**Incline RDL holds 45** — the 3s + 2s pause is the work.
🔥 near-failure OK on leg press, calf raise, leg curl. 🛑 keep it shy on squat, Bulgarian, incline RDL.
formPhilosophy: Confidence is a training variable, and it just moved in your favor — the squat felt the best it ever has at 80 not because the number changed but because you finally trust the bottom. That's the moment to add a little, not a lot: one optional set that you're allowed to walk away from, and one more rung on the lift that's genuinely fresh. Nothing here is a grind, because the thing being built is depth and a ground-out shallow rep is a step backwards dressed up as effort. The Bulgarian moving to the Smith is the same idea from another angle — take the balance tax off and the range opens up on its own. Build the floor, keep it clean, let confidence compound. Building decades, not weeks.
